chunks: And through his chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Animosity towards Ali is disbelief (kufr), and animosity towards the Banu Hashim is hypocrisy (nifaq).
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between kufr and nifaq regarding animosity towards Ali and Banu Hashim?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith establishes a direct theological link between affection for the Prophet’s lineage and the validity of one’s faith, distinguishing between the ultimate state of disbelief (*kufr*) for hating Imam Ali and the state of hypocrisy (*nifaq*) for hating the Banu Hashim. This distinction underscores the unique status of Imam Ali as the focal point of faith, while affirming the broader clan’s role in maintaining the integrity of the prophetic mission. It serves as a foundational proof for the Shia doctrine of *Wilayah*, emphasizing that loyalty to the Ahl al-Bayt is not merely recommended but essential for spiritual survival.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-239 According to the same documentation, the Prophet (S) said, “
Animosity with Ali equals atheism and animosity with the Hashemites equals hypocrisy.”
